title: Intra-model repetition as a hidden mode-collapse failure: measuring 'idea exhaustion' under resampling

original_idea.body:
# Intra-model repetition as a hidden mode-collapse failure

Resample K=50 outputs per prompt at fixed temperature across several open models; plot growth of distinct semantic clusters vs K and fit an effective diversity ceiling. Embedding clustering on a consumer GPU.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (diversity ceiling limits best-of-N safety) but link to catastrophic scenario is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 5: resample, embed, cluster, fit saturation curve — standard tools and public prompts.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 5: tightly scoped single experiment (diversity-vs-K curve) with a clear effective-ceiling metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: open models + embeddings, weak lab incentive, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Resampling K=50 across several models plus embeddings, single consumer GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Intra-model repetition documented; quantifying the saturation ceiling vs sample count may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Direct follow-up to a documented effect; the diversity-ceiling-vs-K quantification is plausibly open.
